turns.input: I look around the square and listen to the market.
I stop beside the road and rest to catch my breath.
I eat some of the food from my travel pack.
I drink water and check my supplies.
I spread my arms and fly to the tower.
I make everyone in Rillford forget that I was here.
I leave the square and travel north along the road.
I look back toward the square and note who came with me.
